lines.text: Oxane's Onboarding Workbench, from Artizent. So, what does it take to set up a new loan?

Before a bank can keep watch over a loan, someone has to set it up. That means reading the whole agreement, then turning it into checks a system can run, without a mistake. Here's how it goes for a bank called Calderwood.

lines.caption: deal
lines.text: Calderwood is lending to a car finance company, and the loan is secured on its car loans.

lines.caption: intake
lines.text: First, the paperwork arrives. The AI sorts every document, and notices that a page is missing.

lines.caption: terms
lines.text: Next, the key terms. The AI reads each one, and shows where it found it.

lines.caption: facility
lines.text: Code checks every answer. This one came from a blurry scan, so it's flagged.

lines.caption: ontology
lines.text: The AI understands lending terms, because it's grounded in Artizent's private credit ontology.

lines.caption: amended
lines.text: This term was changed by a later amendment, and the new value is already applied.

lines.caption: bulk
lines.text: Routine terms are approved together. A person signs off each one.

lines.caption: rules
lines.text: Then the AI turns the agreement's tests into rules a system can run.

lines.caption: ruleEdit
lines.text: Anyone changing a rule sees its effect first, and someone else has to agree.

lines.caption: mapping
lines.text: The AI matches the borrower's loan file to the bank's own fields, so nothing is typed by hand.

lines.caption: validation
lines.text: Now, the real check. There's no AI here. Code tests every loan, to the cent.

lines.caption: bridge
lines.text: The borrower claimed too much, and every dollar of the gap is explained.

lines.caption: drill
lines.text: And some cars appear twice, on two different loans.

lines.caption: queue
lines.text: Anything doubtful goes to one place, and the analyst decides what happens to each one.

lines.caption: sunrise
lines.text: One dealer was spelled two ways. Counted together, it breaks a limit.

lines.caption: approve
lines.text: Then sign-off. The analyst who did the work can't approve it.

lines.caption: reviewer
lines.text: A second analyst reviews every change, and then approves.

lines.caption: approved
lines.text: The loan is ready to watch, with a full record.

lines.caption: results
lines.text: The result: every real problem found, and nothing harmless flagged.
By the end, the loan is set up and ready to watch. Every value traces back to its page, and every doubt was settled by a person. From next month, the regular checks begin.
Every value has a source. Every doubt has an owner. That's the Onboarding Workbench, from Artizent.
